en.html:
Under cover of night, we landed on Enoshima.
Same as yesterday, but the efficiency was a great improvement. Midnight had only just passed and already we were investigating.

Through the curtain of darkness we walked, as though parting it. Probably last night's impression was responsible, but the blackness drowning the landscape seemed even more sinister now. As though more secrets it was keeping.

Without consulting me, my feet became heavy. Very cautious fellows.

en.html:
The 'Fisheries Research Institute' was supposed to stand a little west of the island's center.
The shogunate's map said so, at least.

If map and reality were not on speaking terms, we would have to find the place ourselves. That was why I wanted first to secure a location where some clue definitely remained. How it might help, who could say?

Time, however, was finite. And always less than required.
For a detour, haste was necessary. My feet were taking caution beyond its proper limits and into cowardice. Bas, enough of that. I scolded them into a quicker pace, stopping short of making noise.

en.html:
The 'Fisheries Research Institute' was supposed to stand a little west of the island's center.
The shogunate's map said so, at least.

If map and reality were not on speaking terms, we would have to find the place ourselves. That was why I wanted first to secure a location where some clue definitely remained. How it might help, who could say?

Time, however, was finite. And always less than required.
For a detour, haste was necessary. My feet were taking caution beyond its proper limits and into cowardice. Bas, enough of that. I scolded them into a quicker pace, stopping short of making noise.

Exactly.
Monster. What other name was available for this thing?

Silver skin, almost platinum.
A human shape with nearly everything human abstracted out of it.

And above all—
That bulk.

A whale come ashore.
How many tons? My mind would not even begin the calculation.

And that much of a thing...
Was floating. Hawa mein.

Reality and the sight before me were not agreeing at all. Thoughts would not come together. What to think, what to do, nothing I knew.

Probably I was not the only one in this excellent condition.

戦わねばならない。
　少なくとも彼女らが脱出を果たすまでの間。


　この相手と――
　未だ嘗て見まみえたこともなく、見えることを想像だに
